context: A teacher discusses a research paper on society
purpose: Teach: 波紋/強める/独学/民意/隆盛/不規則/収拾/山手線

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、波紋を呼んだ報道事案、丁寧に扱いましたね。
lines.en: Your paper handled that controversial coverage issue very carefully. The way you treated it was thoughtful.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Slight lean forward. Brief pause before the second sentence—genuine recognition, not throwaway praise. Voice steady and present.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。世論を強める要因、データで示しました。
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to show through the data what factors were actually strengthening public opinion.
lines.style: Focused and serious. Slight tension in the shoulders—he's being precise about what he did. Earnest, not defensive. Voice even and clear.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 独学で研究を続ける市民、興味深い章ですね。
lines.en: That chapter on independent researchers—citizens doing their own studying—that was really compelling.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity in the opening. Slight lift on 「interesting」. Nodding tone. She's tracking something he's building, not just evaluating.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 民意の反映、政治の隆盛と衰退、論じました。
lines.en: I wanted to explore how public will actually gets reflected in those patterns—how political movements rise and fall through them.
lines.style: Careful and methodical. Slight hesitation before the dash—he's finding the right framing. Voice patient, like he's walking her through his thinking step by step.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 不規則な現象、収拾、難しい場合もありますね。
lines.en: And irregular phenomena can be tricky to pin down sometimes—harder to make sense of when they don't follow the pattern.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. Slight exhale mid-thought. Voice drops a touch lower—she's thinking alongside him, not lecturing. Contemplative pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 山手線沿線の地域研究、別章で扱いました。
lines.en: I handled the regional analysis along the Yamanote line in a separate chapter so I could give it the space it needed.
lines.style: Quieter, almost curious about her response. Matter-of-fact delivery but with a slight rising question at the end—checking if that choice made sense to her. Voice steady but open.
